discardChanges: You have unsaved payment changes. Close this modal and discard them?
totalsAdjusted: Order total changed. Payment leg amounts were adjusted to match.
loadFailedDescription: The payment screen did not finish loading. Retry before collecting payment.
loadTimedOut: Payment preparation took too long. Retry before collecting payment.
metadataUnavailableTitle: Some payment details could not be loaded
cardBrandsUnavailable: Card brands are unavailable. Retry to load the available brands.
terminalsUnavailable: Payment terminals are unavailable. Methods requiring a terminal cannot be submitted until this is resolved.
sessionUnavailable: Your payment session could not be verified. Sign out and sign in again before collecting payment.
giftCardInvalid: The applied gift card is no longer valid. Remove it to continue, or retry after checking the card.
reviewChangedDescription: Payment details changed or are being refreshed. Your entries are preserved. Review the updated payment before confirming.
currencyChanged: Currency settings changed while payment was open. Close and reopen payment to review the new currency rules. Your order is preserved.
